rule_audits.clinical_reason: ODS sports supplement evidence on healthy adults cannot be generalized to known renal disease or missing renal history.

sources.applicability: Performance evidence and safety context; not a kidney disease treatment guideline

rule_audits.clinical_reason: Fatigue is nonspecific; iron deficiency and indication for treatment require appropriate assessment.
Hair concerns alone do not establish biotin deficiency or expected efficacy.

sources.applicability: Biotin deficiency, cosmetic claims and laboratory test interference

rule_audits.clinical_reason: A rule requiring current vitamin K supplementation can miss people contemplating vitamin K while taking a vitamin K antagonist.

sources.applicability: Warfarin and vitamin K intake consistency

precautions: warfarin and other vitamin K antagonists

rule_audits.clinical_reason: Chronic insomnia requires clinical assessment and evidence-based nonpharmacologic management; supplement is not universal first-line therapy.
Omega-3 safety and cardiovascular outcomes depend on formulation and dose; review bleeding risk and atrial fibrillation where relevant.

sources.applicability: Omega-3 supplement safety and clinical evidence

rule_audits.clinical_reason: Numeric caffeine intake cannot safely be evaluated using an unparsed string comparison.

sources.applicability: Caffeine exercise outcomes, adverse effects and typical intake contexts

precautions: caffeine from coffee, energy drinks and pre-workout products
